label: External procedure-code mappings for the 16 fixed internal procedure keys (identifiers preserved; codes shown only as printed in opened documents)
policy: Internal keys are never renamed. A mapping is a pointer to where a code was printed, not an assertion that the user's procedure IS that code; a code printed on the user's own estimate or claim (USER) takes precedence. Mappings with review_required=true are shown with their alternatives, never silently chosen.

reuse_terms.note: CDT is copyrighted by the American Dental Association; this file does not reproduce the CDT catalog. Code numbers and descriptors appear only as printed in the cited public documents (each carries its own ADA notice).
